integrity: An exact analytic proof accompanies deterministic rational and seeded sampling checks; finite computations do not establish unbounded claims.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple cactus graphs only; overlapping cycles are excluded.
Strict John-versus-inertia anisotropy is asserted for graphs with both cycle edges and bridges.
Equivalent statements under central cube-section/B-spline or product-isotropy terminology may exist.
No external independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Cycle-block isotropic defects and John–inertia anisotropy in cactus Lipschitz polytopes
